Immutable GitHub releases · SHA-256 digests for the app zip and release.json

The launcher reads `release.json` automatically. Most people only need the app zip.

GitHub lists the SHA-256 digest of each uploaded asset below, and `Get-FileHash <file>` in PowerShell prints the same value for your copy.

The "Source code" downloads are generated by GitHub rather than by this project's build. They carry no digest. Use the app zip.
